heroIntroduction:
Get a full, independent review of your packaging data, so you only buy the PRNs you actually owe and only pay the EPR fees you should.

Ecoveritas is fully independent of compliance schemes, so our only interest is getting your numbers right.
alert: Why now: PRN prices have risen 3–4x. Accurate packaging data matters more than ever.
columnsLeft:
Your PRN obligation and EPR fee are only as accurate as the data behind them.

Packaging data is complex and changes over time. Miscategorised packaging, incorrect weights or wrong material classifications can mean buying tonnage you don't owe and paying fees you shouldn't. A fresh review helps confirm every tonne is reported correctly.

howCards.title: 02 · We review your data

howCards.title: 03 · No upfront cost
howCards.text: Selected producers get their audit at no cost, with nothing to pay upfront.

ctaHtml:
Apply for a free PRN audit

Use the form to apply. So we can assess your application, please include:

  • "PRN audit"
  • Your annual turnover (a rough bracket is fine)
  • The number of SKUs you handle
